title: NFTxLV SPECIAL! GAMEPLAY FOOTAGE, LIVE REACTIONS AND MORE! | Copi Cafe 68 | Cornucopias
description:
The NFTxLV conference in Las Vegas might be in the rearview mirror, but the adrenaline rush from our game showcase is still going strong! 

In this episode of Copi Cafe, we're showcasing the stunning visuals and experience of our racing game, mining game, and briefly touching on the free-roam experience in Solace, where our community shares their firsthand experiences.

If that wasn't enough, we've gone the extra mile by capturing exclusive interviews with our dedicated community members, who traveled from all corners of the globe to share their unfiltered reactions to the gameplay.

Huge thanks to Farid of Dapp Central for hosting this special edition of COPI Cafe, you can find his channel linked below: 

https://www.youtube.com/@DappCentral

00:00 Beverage Choices
02:51 Message to the Community 
05:41 New Features
08:08 Zeke & Nathan Interview
10:42 Fryler Interview
13:04 COPI Farmer Interview
16:54 Micky Watkins World Mobile CEO Interview
19:07 Josh - LateGameCrypto Interview
24:34 Chris - Cheeky Crypto Interview
29:57 Duffy Interview
34:34 David, Creative Director Interview
47:58 Rick McCracken Interview
52:14 Patrik Tobler - NMKR CEO Interview
55:44 Closing Section

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items. 

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/cornucopiasgame

Fair disclaimer: Copi Leaks are brief glimpses into the game's mechanics as they currently stand. Everything we leak can be assumed to be unfinished, is subject to change, or may never be seen again. So enjoy it while you can, and be sure to share this Copi Leak with everyone you know!
